Eve L: Quick sync request — Nimbus wants to onboard ap-southeast-2. Need marketplace entitlements, GPU quota (A100-80GB preferred), KMS/HSM details, and a recommended announce cadence. Can partnerships + security + ops weigh in?
Nora (Nimbus): Hi all! We can commit 15 A100-80GB reserved to start (nb-a100-80-prod). We also have a smaller A30 SKU for burst: nb-a30-24-burst. Willing to allow burst to A30 for best-effort traffic. Need Redwood to submit the marketplace entitlement sheet and confirm KMS integration pattern.
Sam P: Ops note — we'll need exact SKU ids, region code, and an initial go-live target to request quotas. Also want expected ramp (customers/month) so we can recommend buffering.
Nora (Nimbus): SKUs: nb-a100-80-prod, nb-a30-24-burst. Region: ap-southeast-2. Go-live target: 2026-06-15 (tentative). Ramp: estimate 3-5 customers first 30 days.
Liang C: Security question — Nimbus, do you require CloudHSM/HSM-backed keys or can we use KMIP-compatible external KMS? What's your key rotation cadence? Any restrictions on exporting keys or backups?
Nora (Nimbus): We require HSM-backed keys (FIPS 140-2 level) and prefer AWS CloudHSM or a customer-managed HSM. Rotation cadence default 180 days, can be shortened to 90 on request. No key export; envelope encryption OK. Logs with minimal PII can reside in-region.
Rina M: I'll prepare the entitlement payload and submit to marketplace. Draft below for review:
```json
{
  "partner": "NimbusCloud",
  "region": "ap-southeast-2",
  "skus": ["nb-a100-80-prod","nb-a30-24-burst"],
  "reserved_capacity": 15,
  "burst_policy": "a30-only-for-best-effort",
  "go_live_date": "2026-06-15"
}
```
Eve L: Heads-up — product analytics expects ~40% chance of surge above reserved in month 1. Nora, what is lead time to request extra commit if we need more GPUs?
Nora (Nimbus): Extra commits typically 10 business days, but we can prioritize if we have forecast + committed customers. Fast bursts to A30 available immediately within region capacity.
Sam P: Ops runbook ask — can we get a minimal canary/runbook checklist? Something like: 1) validate 95th p95 latency < 250ms, 2) sustained throughput 800k tokens/hr, 3) fallback to A30 < 30% traffic.
Nora (Nimbus): We'll run a partner-side canary on our end too. Canary window proposal: 2026-06-08 09:00-12:00 UTC.
OpsBot: canary-schedule: 2026-06-08T09:00Z-2026-06-08T12:00Z; notify=#eng-runtime #eng-sre
MarketplaceBot: marketplace-submission: submission_id=msub-20260502-879; status=review_pending; reviewer=marketplace-team@nimbuscloud.com
Liang C: Legal/compliance note — we need a short addendum for in-region data residency + HSM requirement before go-live. Rina, can partnerships get that signed?
Rina M: Yep — I'll coordinate with legal and attach a draft by EOD Friday. Also marketing wants a 2-line co-announcement blurb; Nora can you post partner-approved copy here?
Nora (Nimbus): Sure. Draft blurb: "Nimbus and Redwood Inference launch low-latency inference capacity in AP Southeast to serve enterprise customers with dedicated GPU capacity and in-region key management." Will refine for marketing.
Eve L: Good. Proposed timeline: entitlement submitted this week, legal addendum signed by 2026-06-01, internal canary 2026-06-08, entitlements/quotas confirmed 2026-06-10, go-live 2026-06-15, public announce 2026-06-29 (two-week embargo). Sound realistic?
Sam P: Sounds good. I'll prepare the runbook and the scaling playbook.
Rina M: Filing checklist here: entitlement submission (msub-20260502-879), legal addendum pending, canary scheduled, marketing blurb pending final sign-off. I'll post links once docs are in drive. :white_check_mark:
Nora (Nimbus): We'll share partner-side capacity charts and invite ops to the canary calendar invite shortly.
Eve L: Thanks everyone. If anyone hits a blocker, ping me and I'll escalate with Nimbus.
Rina M: Uploaded legal addendum draft: https://drive.redwood.ai/partners/nimbus/ap-se-legal-draft

Eve L: Great — locking on dates and will follow up on calendar invites. :rocket:
